tailoring.headline: E-commerce Growth & Pricing Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and REST/OCC APIs, with proven success designing pricing and promotions engines, PIM/ERP data pipelines, and stakeholder-focused business analysis. Skilled in CI/CD, cloud deployments and AI-assisted development, driving revenue-focused growth. I consistently translate business goals into scalable technical solutions, ensuring optimal performance and market competitiveness.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-commerce Growth & Pricing Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Dealavo’s focus on data-driven pricing and growth, and I see a direct fit with my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background in building scalable e-commerce platforms and pricing engines positions me to contribute immediately to your team.

bullets.label: Pricing & Promotions
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented pricing and promotions functionality within SAP Commerce Cloud, delivering robust pricing rules and catalog updates that supported global product launches.

bullets.label: API & Data Integration
bullets.text: I built OCC REST APIs and end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) for Rockwell and Shell, ensuring seamless product, ERP and MDM synchronization.

bullets.label: Business Consulting
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role I gathered requirements, wrote user stories and functional specs, and coordinated with international stakeholders to translate business goals into scalable e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Growth Enablement
bullets.text: Through performance-tuned backend services, CI/CD automation and AI-assisted development I accelerated feature delivery, enabling revenue-driving capabilities such as dynamic pricing and personalized promotions.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026 – happy to discuss further.

tailoring.why_company: Dealavo’s mission to empower online retailers with real-time pricing intelligence aligns perfectly with my experience building data-driven pricing and promotions engines on SAP Commerce Cloud. I am excited by your AI-powered platform that helps brands optimise price points and capture growth, and I see a direct fit for my expertise in PIM/ERP integration, API development and business-focused e-commerce solutions to accelerate Dealavo’s client success.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Dealavo to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in building pricing and growth solutions, helping retailers maximise revenue through intelligent e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering pricing and integration solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Dealavo’s e-commerce growth team. Could we discuss the E-commerce Growth & Pricing Consultant role?
tailoring.email_subject: Application for E-commerce Growth & Pricing Consultant – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the E-commerce Growth & Pricing Consultant position at Dealavo. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, pricing engines and data integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can drive revenue-focused growth for your clients. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs.
